description_en: Creates file metadata records in a dataset in batches
description_zh: 批量创建数据集下的文件元数据记录
name: CreateDatasetFileMetas

parameters.help_en: The dataset ID. For information about how to obtain the dataset ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457222.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据集ID。如何获取数据集ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457222.html
parameters.name: dataset_id

fields.example: The first image file in the dataset.
fields.name: comment

fields.help_en: The MIME type of the file. Contains Type and SubType
fields.name: content_type

fields.help_en: The file creation time in ISO 8601 format
fields.help_zh: 文件创建时间，格式：ISO8601格式
fields.name: file_create_time

fields.help_en: The file fingerprint value. Used to determine the uniqueness of file content. This value changes when the file content is modified. OSS files use ETag, and NAS files use MD5 values
fields.help_zh: 文件指纹值。用于确定文件内容的唯一性，文件内容修改后该值会发生变化。OSS文件使用ETag，NAS文件使用MD5值
fields.name: file_finger_print

fields.help_en: The file type. Same as MIME Type
fields.name: file_type

fields.help_en: The last modification time of the file in ISO 8601 format
fields.help_zh: 文件最后修改时间，格式：ISO8601格式
fields.name: file_update_time

fields.help_en: The specific metadata of the file, not searchable. In JSON string format
fields.help_zh: 文件的特定元数据，暂不具备检索能力。JSON String格式
fields.name: meta_attributes
tags

fields.help_en:
The unique URI of the file. Used to record the unique file path. Supports file paths in OSS and NAS.
<details>
<summary>OSS</summary>
oss://${bucket}/${path}
</details>
<details>
<summary>NAS</summary>
nas://${fileSystemId}/${path}
</details>
fields.help_zh:
文件唯一URI。用于记录文件唯一路径。支持OSS、NAS下的文件路径。
<details>
<summary>OSS</summary>
oss://${bucket}/${path}
</details>
<details>
<summary>NAS</summary>
nas://${fileSystemId}/${path}
</details>
fields.name: uri

parameters.help_en: The list of file metadata entries
parameters.name: dataset_file_metas

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace where the dataset resides. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据集所在工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id
